title: Premium Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Premium Vegetable Fried Rice is an elevated restaurant-style fried rice featuring fragrant jasmine or basmati rice tossed with colorful crisp vegetables, earthy mushrooms, sweet baby corn, and roasted cashews. High-heat wok cooking develops a smoky wok hei character, while soy sauce, sesame oil, and aromatic garlic and ginger create a rich and balanced finish.

ingredients.title: For the Rice
items: Long-grain jasmine rice or basmati rice – 2 cups, cooked and cooled

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: Baby corn – ½ cup, sliced diagonally
Button mushrooms – ½ cup, thinly sliced
Peas – ½ cup, fresh or frozen

ingredients.title: For Crunch & Flavor
items: Roasted cashews – ¼ cup, lightly crushed

ingredients.title: For the Sauce & Seasoning
items: Soy sauce – 2–3 tbsp (light soy for flavor and dark soy for color)
White pepper or black pepper – ½ tsp

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Rice
steps: Cook the rice with water, salt, and 1 tsp oil until tender.
Spread the cooked rice out and allow it to cool completely.
For the best texture, refrigerate the rice overnight so the grains become firm and separate.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Ingredients
steps: Slice the mushrooms and baby corn, and dice the carrot and bell peppers uniformly for even cooking.
Finely chop the onion and spring onions.
Prepare the minced garlic and grated ginger before heating the wok.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Roasting the Cashews
steps: Heat a dry pan over medium heat.
Add the cashews and lightly roast until golden and fragrant.
Remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Stir-Frying the Vegetables
steps: Heat 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Add garlic, ginger, and onion and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add carrots, peas, baby corn, and bell peppers.
Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for another 1–2 minutes until lightly browned.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Combining with the Rice
steps: Push the vegetables toward the sides of the wok.
Add the cold cooked rice to the center.
Break apart any clumps and stir-fry quickly over high heat.
Combine the rice and vegetables evenly.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce if using, and white or black pepper.
Toss gently but thoroughly until the rice is evenly seasoned.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Finishing & Garnishing
steps: Drizzle sesame oil over the fried rice and toss gently.
Fold in the roasted cashews while keeping them slightly crunchy.
Garnish with chopped spring onions, fried shallots, and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve immediately in a wide, shallow serving dish.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as a premium vegetarian main course or side dish.
Pair with chili chicken, hot garlic vegetables, or other Chinese stir-fried dishes.
Present in a wide, shallow dish for an elegant restaurant-style appearance.
Serve immediately so the vegetables and cashews retain their contrasting textures.

chefTips: Use day-old refrigerated rice for the best texture; firm, cold grains are less likely to become mushy.
Maintain high heat throughout the stir-frying process to develop authentic wok hei.
Cook the vegetables in stages so each ingredient retains its ideal texture and color.
Roast the cashews separately and add them at the end to preserve their crunch.
Button or shiitake mushrooms can be used for earthy depth and a more premium flavor profile.
Balance soft rice, crisp vegetables, and crunchy cashews for a layered restaurant-quality texture.
Serve in a wide, shallow dish and garnish precisely for a professional presentation.
